extracted.subtask_short: peer review guide for early researchers
extracted.subtask_description: A practical guide explaining how the peer review process works, the challenges it faces, new peer review models, and how early career researchers can get involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanation of how peer review works
rubrics_metrics.description: A guide to peer review for early career researchers written by members of the VoYS network ... to find out how peer review works.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide aims to 'open up the “black box” of peer review' and explain the peer review process; intended as an explanatory resource for those unfamiliar with the mechanics of peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Challenges and future of peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: The guide explains the challenges for peer review and the future of peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers are shown common problems the system faces (takes time, relies on trust, imperfect) and discussion of evolving pressures and potential reforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role of peer review in society
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains the crucial role peer review plays within society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextualises peer review beyond gatekeeping — how it contributes to public trust, research quality, and scientific communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to get involved in peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: The guide describes how early career researchers can get involved in peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical advice and pathways for participation (e.g., becoming a reviewer), targeting researchers who want to contribute to the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: New peer review processes to be aware of
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduces and explains new processes like collaborative peer review, post-publication peer review, transparent peer review and the rise of pre-prints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights alternate and emerging review models and their implications so reviewers and authors can recognise and engage with different workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact of changing attitudes among stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Reflects changing attitudes of researchers, publishers and the public toward peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages awareness of stakeholder perspectives when participating in or evaluating peer review (e.g., expectations around openness, speed, and accountability).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of new media for dissemination
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes the increasing use of new media to disseminate research findings and its relevance to peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers are encouraged to consider how pre-prints, social media and other platforms affect the timing, visibility, and post-publication critique of research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Framing the guide as timely and date-stamped
rubrics_metrics.description: All our guides are date stamped and reflect the scientific findings and knowledge available at the time of publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should treat guidance as time-bound and check for more recent developments in peer review practice and policy.
